name: review-notification (example)
description: Illustrates how an external n8n instance could notify staff when a new review needs attention. Business logic (classification, workflow, approval) stays in the app — this workflow only reacts to an event and sends a message.

nodes.name: Webhook: review.created
nodes.notes: POST payload: { reviewId, locationId, rating, sentiment, author }

nodes.name: Notify staff (Slack/email)
nodes.notes: Send a message linking back to /dashboard/reviews so a human approves the reply — this workflow never publishes a reply itself.

parameters.text: New negative review from {{$json["author"]}} needs a reply approval: {{$json["reviewId"]}}
